run_segmentation_inference_whole: run whole image segmentation inference on an input tensor using a segmentation model with bilinear rescaling
run_segmentation_inference_slide: run sliding window segmentation inference on an image with configurable crop size and stride for overlapping predictions
run_inference_with_horizontal_flip_tta: run segmentation inference with horizontal flip test-time augmentation applied to revert the flipped prediction
run_inference_with_m2f_decoder: run segmentation inference using an m2f decoder head that combines mask predictions and class logits with einsum
run_inference_with_output_activation: run segmentation inference with a softmax or sigmoid output activation applied to the final prediction tensor
